title: Incan Moral Rationalism & Quechua Humanism
summary: Inca Garcilaso de la Vega's cross-cultural synthesis establishing that pre-Columbian Incan civilization attained high moral rationalism, natural theology (worship of the invisible creator Pachacamac), and a harmonious socialist commonwealth. Garcilaso synthesized Incan solar metaphysics with Renaissance Neoplatonic love (León Hebreo), proving the universal dignity and intellectual capacity of Indigenous civilizations.
